svg.title: Scales and lace on deep skin in four pictures. 1: a teal, blue and purple sponge base in a curve from the temple around the outside of each eye onto the cheekbone, never on the eyelid. 2: dark scales dabbed through a scale stencil held flat on the temple and cheekbone, not over the eyes. 3: white highlights on some of the scales and a few dots. Done: a band of freehand white lace across the forehead above the brows: scallops, loops, dots and a fine net with dot flowers.
